title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Supply Chain
Job Location: Crewe
Shifts: Regular days
Hourly Rate: £19.82 PAYE - £25.72 Umbrella
Hours Per Week: 37 hours
Duration: 12 - Months
Start Date: ASAP

Company Summary:
A global leader in Rolling Stock vehicle manufacturing, service and maintenance.

Position Summary:
Successful applicants would be responsible for the continuation and improvement of the supply chain relationships within the nominated suppliers to ensure that material is delivered on time and within budgets.

Position Tasks and Responsibilities:
Monitoring of supplier performance.
Performance reviews with supply chain.
Monitoring inventory.
Validation of material demands.
Expedite material deliveries to ensure OTD targets are met.
Maintain an inventory database.
Stock management in line with requirements of production.
PO and invoicing negotiations.
Reporting on KPI's.
Materials control.

Person Profile:
Supply chain experience is preferred but not essential as you will be working in the Supply Chain team
Inventory management experience.
Good understanding of materials management.
Strong negotiation skills.
Knowledge of database systems such as SAP.
Good analytical skills.
Competent on Excel at Intermediate level
Experience of LEAN principles (5's, Kaisen, CI, Visualisation Management)

Contact Information:
Email:
Phone:

PLEASE NOTE ALL APPLICANTS MUST BE ABLE TO PASS AN DRUGS AND ALCOHOL TEST BEFORE BEING OFFERED A POSITION (this is standard procedure on Rail depots)

Please note due to the volume of applications, we can only commit to contact those candidates we deem suitable for the position. However, we may retain your details and contact you in the future should suitable positions arise.

title: Contact Centre Agent - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Part-Time Payroll Assistant
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Adele Carr Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting on behalf of a well-established and highly respected accountancy practice for an experienced Part-Time Payroll Administrator to join their growing payroll team.

This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a friendly, supportive business that continues to expand through organic growth and acquisition. The company offers a flexible approach to working hours, a collaborative team environment and genuine opportunities for your role to grow as the business continues to develop.

If you're an experienced Payroll Administrator looking for a part-time position that offers flexibility, stability and a great team culture, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

Working alongside an experienced team, you'll support the day-to-day processing of multiple client payrolls, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time while maintaining compliance with current payroll legislation.

The business is looking for someone who enjoys working as part of a close-knit team, has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in delivering an exceptional service to clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing weekly and monthly payrolls of up to 80 employees per payroll.
- Processing new starters, leavers, statutory payments, sickness, time sheets and payroll amendments.
- Carrying out National Minimum Wage checks.
- Assisting with the onboarding of new payroll clients.
- Responding to payroll queries via telephone, email and in person.
- Completing monthly pension uploads and reconciling pension contributions.
- Ensuring compliance with Pension Regulator requirements.
- Maintaining GDPR compliance and payroll accuracy.
- Supporting the Payroll Manager with the smooth running of the payroll function.

Working Hours

This role is offered on a part-time basis (15-22.5 hours per week).

The successful candidate must be available to work on Tuesdays, with flexibility around how the remaining hours are worked. The client is happy to consider shorter working days (for example, 6-hour days) or alternative working patterns to suit both the successful candidate and the needs of the business.

As the payroll department continues to grow, there is potential for additional hours in the future.

Benefits
- 36 days holiday inclusive of Bank Holidays/Christmas period (this is the full time equivalent)
- Pension scheme - 5% employer contribution
- Option to buy/sell a maximum of 5 days holiday
- Employee assistance programme (which includes; Life support, Legal information, Bereavement support, Medical Information, CBT & Managerial Support).
- Life Assurance cover
- Option of salary sacrifice pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity/paternity/shared parental pay
- Enhanced sick pay
- Referral scheme
- Paid volunteer time
- Long service enhancements to employer pension contribution and holiday entitlement
- On site parking
- Team social events

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking for genuine flexibility while continuing to build a career in payroll. Whether you're currently working within an accountancy practice or an in-house payroll team, this role offers the chance to join a growing business where your contribution will be valued and where there is real scope for your hours and responsibilities to develop over time.

If you're looking for a flexible part-time payroll opportunity with an employer that genuinely values its people, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Adele Carr Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

title: Graduate Town Planner
description:
Job Title: Graduate Town Planner

Ref: BM337

Location: Macclesfield

Salary: £27,000 - £30,000

This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic Town Planning consultancy who provide their expertise to high profile projects across various sectors across the UK. They are on the lookout for a talented and proactive Graduate Town Planner to join their Macclesfield offices.

Benefits for the role of Graduate Town Planner include:
- Highly competitive salary
- Contributory pension scheme
- Generous holiday allowance
- Professional development
- Personal development

Duties for the role of Graduate Town Planner:
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications.
- Supporting planning appraisals and site assessments.
- Undertaking research into planning policy, legislation and local planning matters.
- Assisting with planning statements, reports and other supporting documentation.
- Monitoring planning applications and liaising with local planning authorities.
- Supporting consultants with pre-application enquiries and planning negotiations.
- Assisting with planning appeals and development plan representations.
- Carrying out research into development opportunities and planning constraints

Requirements for the role of Graduated Town Planner:
- A degree in Town Planning, Urban Planning, Geography, Urban Design or a related subject.
- A genuine interest in the planning and development sector.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Good research and analytical abilities.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- A professional and personable approach when dealing with clients and stakeholders.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- A willingness to learn and develop professionally.

If this role interests you or if you are interested in searching for other roles relating to Town Planning please feel free to contact Ben Moore on or email . There are many more roles available on our website at . This is a permanent role

title: Graduate Town Planner
description:
Graduate Planner

Macclesfield Competitive salary Full training & professional development

Are you a recent graduate looking to build a career in town planning?

We're currently working with an established and growing planning consultancy that is looking to appoint a Graduate Planner to join its team in Macclesfield.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent planning graduate to gain hands-on experience across a broad range of projects, working alongside experienced planning professionals and developing the skills needed to progress within the industry.

The Role

As a Graduate Planner, you'll support the planning team across a variety of projects, gaining exposure to the full planning process and developing your professional knowledge.

You'll have the opportunity to work on a range of planning applications and projects while receiving support and guidance from experienced colleagues.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications.
- Supporting planning research and site appraisals.
- Reviewing local planning policies and planning documents.
- Undertaking research into planning history and relevant legislation.
- Assisting with planning statements, reports and other project documentation.
- Communicating with clients, local authorities and other stakeholders.
- Monitoring planning applications and providing updates to clients.
- Supporting senior planners with a variety of residential, commercial and other development projects.
- Keeping up to date with changes to planning policy and legislation.
- Developing your professional knowledge and progressing towards becoming a fully qualified planning professional.

Requirements

We're looking for a motivated graduate who is keen to establish a long-term career within planning.

Ideally, you'll have:
- A degree in Town Planning, Planning & Development or a closely related subject.
- A genuine interest in the planning and development sector.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent research and analytical abilities.
- Good organisation and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn.

Previous planning experience, including internships or placement experience, would be beneficial but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive graduate salary.
- Full training and support from experienced planning professionals.
- Exposure to a diverse range of planning projects.
- Excellent opportunity to develop your planning career.
- Support towards relevant professional development and progression.
- Friendly and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity to gain valuable consultancy experience in a growing planning business.
- Macclesfield-based role.

This is a great opportunity for a planning graduate looking for their first step into consultancy and wanting to develop their career within an experienced and supportive team.

Interested?

For more information, or to discuss the opportunity confidentially, please contact:

Efan Thomas

Apply now to enjoy excellent career prospects while reaping the rewards of making a difference to others every day. Helping others improve and turn their lives around theres no better feeling.
